bullets: On Wednesday 18 November, DLD recorded 410 sales worth AED 1.2bn, down 13.3 percent versus a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 56.1 percent of sales, compared to a seven-day average of 59.7 percent.
The median price was AED 1,644 per square foot, down 2.4 percent over 30 days and down 5.4 percent from last year.
Over the past seven days, the busiest areas were JVC with 195 sales, Business Bay with 139 sales, and Saih Shuaib 1 with 129 sales.
In October new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2 percent on the month.
talking_points: Dubai Marina tops apartment rentals while Al Jaddaf villa rents continue to surge.
Dubai property is proving more affordable compared to Mumbai and Delhi markets.
The tax system and Golden Visa remain key factors in attracting wealthy Indian investors.

items.impact_reason: Mega airport expansion boosts long-term regional property demand.
